Don't see your neighborhood? Ask on the first call.

Sell an Inherited House — Probate, No Cleanout

We buy inherited houses regularly, including ones still in probate. If the deed is still in the name of the person who passed, probate usually comes first — and there is no cleanout: leave what you don't want.

Sell a House With Tenants in Place

Tenants stay in place through closing. You do not need to evict anyone, wait out a lease, or fix the place up first — we take the house with the tenancy exactly as it is.

Sell a House Behind on Payments

The newest letter from your servicer holds the number that matters. A cash sale can close on your timeline, before the process runs any further.

From First Call to Closing — Six Steps to Sell Your House As-Is

Nothing moves forward without your say-so, and you can stop at any step.

1

The free first call

A free 15-minute first call, with Victor directly. You talk about the house and what's weighing on you. No obligation.

2

A short walk-through

Victor sees the house exactly as it sits. No cleaning, no repairs, no staging first.

3

A written offer, with the math shown

One written offer with the math shown, and the SB 155 disclosure explained before you sign. We handle the contract, the title work, and the standard closing costs.

4

Paperwork & title

We handle the contract, the title work, and the standard closing costs. Probate or tenant situations are mapped here, with you.

5

Your time to decide

No expiration pressure. Take the number, talk it over, and call back weeks later if you want.

6

Closing on your date

Closing on your date — as little as 14 days when the title is clear, or on the date you choose.

Sell Your House Fast — Questions, Answered Straight

Can I sell my house as-is without fixing anything?+

Yes. As-is means as-is: leave the repairs, the mess, even furniture you don't want. We price the property in its current condition and handle everything after closing.

How fast can I sell my house for cash?+

As little as 14 days when the title is clear — and slower when you need it slower. You pick the closing date.

How is my cash offer calculated?+

Victor shows you four numbers on the call: what similar houses sold for, what the repairs cost, the holding and closing costs, and the cash offer that remains.

Do you buy houses with tenants?+

Yes. Tenants stay in place through closing — ask about your leases on the first call.

Can I sell an inherited house in probate?+

Yes. Tell us where probate stands on the first call and we map the timeline with you.

Are there any fees or commissions?+

No agent commissions and no listing fees — there is no agent and no listing. We also cover standard closing costs, so the offer number is the number you plan on.
